mapper.sql: select answer_id, record_id, paper_question_id, user_answer, is_correct, score, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from biz_safety_exam_answer
mapper.select: where record_id = #{recordId} and del_flag = '0' order by answer_id
mapper.insert:

record_id, paper_question_id, user_answer, is_correct, score, create_time,
#{recordId}, #{paperQuestionId}, #{userAnswer}, #{isCorrect}, #{score}, sysdate(),

insert into biz_safety_exam_answer (record_id, paper_question_id, user_answer, create_time) values (#{recordId}, #{paperQuestionId}, #{userAnswer}, sysdate()) on duplicate key update user_answer = #{userAnswer}, update_time = sysdate()

insert into biz_safety_exam_answer (record_id, paper_question_id, user_answer, create_time) values
(#{item.recordId}, #{item.paperQuestionId}, #{item.userAnswer}, sysdate())
on duplicate key update user_answer = values(user_answer), update_time = sysdate()
mapper.update: update biz_safety_exam_answer set is_correct = #{isCorrect}, score = #{score}, update_time = sysdate() where record_id = #{recordId} and paper_question_id = #{paperQuestionId}
update biz_safety_exam_answer set del_flag = '2' where answer_id = #{answerId}
mapper.select: select pq.id as paperQuestionId, pq.content as content, pq.question_type as questionType, pq.score as score, count(a.answer_id) as answerCount, coalesce(sum(case when a.is_correct = '1' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as correctCount, round((count(a.answer_id) - coalesce(sum(case when a.is_correct = '1' then 1 else 0 end), 0)) / count(a.answer_id), 4) as errorRate, q.category_id as categoryId, c.category_name as categoryName from biz_safety_exam_paper_question pq left join biz_safety_exam_answer a on a.paper_question_id = pq.id and a.del_flag = '0' and a.record_id in (select record_id from biz_safety_exam_record where exam_id = #{examId} and del_flag = '0' and exam_result = '2') left join biz_safety_exam_question q on q.question_id = pq.question_id left join biz_safety_exam_category c on c.category_id = q.category_id where pq.paper_id = (select paper_id from biz_safety_exam where exam_id = #{examId} and del_flag = '0') and pq.del_flag = '0' group by pq.id, pq.content, pq.question_type, pq.score, q.category_id, c.category_name order by errorRate desc, pq.sort_no asc

select r.user_name as userName, d.dept_name as deptName, pq.sort_no as sortNo, pq.question_type as questionType, pq.content as content, a.user_answer as answer, pq.answer as correctAnswer, a.is_correct as isCorrect, a.score as score, r.submit_time as submitTime from biz_safety_exam_answer a join biz_safety_exam_record r on r.record_id = a.record_id and r.del_flag = '0' join biz_safety_exam_paper_question pq on pq.id = a.paper_question_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = r.dept_id where r.exam_id = #{examId} and a.del_flag = '0' and r.exam_result = '2' order by r.record_id asc, pq.sort_no asc
